newsitem.title: GERMANY: Text of agreed joint Waigel-Tietmeyer statement.
newsitem.headline: Text of agreed joint Waigel-Tietmeyer statement.

text.p: German Finance Minister Theo Waigel on Wednesday made the following statement to parliament after divergent interpretations of the outcome of a meeting between him and Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer on Tuesday:
"To avoid all confusion, I want precisely and word-for-word to quote the terms of what was orally agreed between Mr Tietmeyer and me (on Tuesday):
'At the conclusion of today's discussion between Bundesbank President Tietmeyer and Finance Minister Waigel, the following was agreed:
- firstly, Bundesbank President Tietmeyer and Finance Minister Waigel today had a conversation about plans for new regulations concerning the valuation of Bundesbank balances.

- secondly, that there will be a serious attempt to seek a mutually acceptable solution that will permit a revaluation of certain certain assets in the year 1997 with a pay-out (of resulting profits) to take effect in 1998.

- thirdly, discussions over specific legal formulations are taking place between the Finance Ministry and the Bundesbank, the results of which will be taken to the relevant working parties of parliament.'" -- Bonn Newsroom +49 228 260 97160
